dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.careIntro: I a koe e tūhura ana i a RETH, kei te mahi au i tua atu hei āwhina i tō mōhio kare ā-roto. Ka tātari ahau i te hototahi hōhonu, ka rapu i ngā aho hono, ā, ka mātua mātua ko ia whakawhiti kōrero e whai tikanga ana.
dashboard.quickReady: Kua rite koe ki te hono?
dashboard.quickReadyDesc: Tūtakina ngā tāngata hōu e rite ana ngā hiahia
dashboard.noSuggestions: Kāore he whakaaro e waatea ana
dashboard.modalIntro: Ko CARE (Context-Aware Recommendation Engine) te pūkaha hototahi o RETH, ka aromatawai i ngā taha e whā:
dashboard.modalAttributes: raraunga mārama pērā i te pakeke, ngā hiahia me ngā pūkenga.
dashboard.modalRelevance: te ōritenga o te tikanga me te tāwehenga hihiri.
dashboard.modalEngagement: te whakatika i runga i te whakawhiti whanaunga tuturu.
dashboard.modalClosing: Nā tēnei huarahi, ehara ngā tūtohu i te tūponotanga noa, engari he hononga whai tikanga.
